game_title: Not Negator – Pearl Divers' Lagoon Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Coastal Port – Pearl Divers' Lagoon, a lagoon of pearl divers: the dock cartographer must handle rogue crabs while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Not Negator: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the dock cartographer slips through safely.
theme: Coastal Port – Pearl Divers' Lagoon: a lagoon of pearl divers
core_gameplay_loop: In Pearl Divers' Lagoon, repeat each round: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the dock cartographer slips through safely. Each round, rogue crabs strike the signal flag, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stealth value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the signal flag from rogue crabs in Pearl Divers' Lagoon: keep the stealth meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 59-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: stealth drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 59-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 5 (applied tier): Not Negator
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Not Negator' (Week 3 slot 5), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Pearl Divers' Lagoon'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stealth changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crabs in Pearl Divers' Lagoon.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 59 seconds while stealth > 0.
